modules.name: syn_fifo

always_blocks.raw_code:
begin : WRITE_POINTER
  if (rst) begin
    wr_pointer <= 0;
  end else if (wr_valid) begin
    wr_pointer <= wr_pointer + 1;
  end
end

begin : READ_POINTER
  if (rst) begin
    rd_pointer <= 0;
  end else if (rd_valid) begin
    rd_pointer <= rd_pointer + 1;
  end
end

begin : READ_DATA
  if (rst) begin
    data_out <= 0;
  end else if (rd_valid) begin
    data_out <= data_ram;
  end
end

modules.name: ram_dp_ar_aw

always_blocks.raw_code:
begin : PORT0_WRITE
  if (cs_0 && we_0) begin
    mem[address_0] <= data_0;
  end
end

begin : PORT0_READ
  if (cs_0 && oe_0) begin
    data_0_out = mem[address_0];
  end else begin
    data_0_out = {DATA_WIDTH{1'bz}};
  end
end

begin : PORT1_WRITE
  if (cs_1 && we_1) begin
    mem[address_1] <= data_1;
  end
end

begin : PORT1_READ
  if (cs_1 && oe_1) begin
    data_1_out = mem[address_1];
  end else begin
    data_1_out = {DATA_WIDTH{1'bz}};
  end
end
